Max Cohen is an Assistant Professor in the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering at North Carolina State University (NC State). Max earned the B.S. in Mechanical Engineering from the University of Florida in 2018, the M.S. in Mechanical Engineering from Boston University (BU) in 2022, and the Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering from BU in 2023. Prior to joining NC State in 2025, Max served as a Postdoctoral Scholar at the California Institute of Technology (Caltech) from 2023-2025. Notable awards received include a National Science Foundation Graduate Research Fellowship in 2019, an Outstanding Dissertation in Mechanical Engineering award from BU in 2023, and the best paper award at the 2025 Conference on Learning for Dynamics and Control.
